# Real example --mods-manifest for apps/server. Format: so_path|function-name per line
# (blank lines and # comments skipped). Deliberately simpler than apps/dynmod_poc's own
# testdata/manifest.txt -- no expected value or call arguments, since a real running server
# doesn't self-check a mod's result the way a proof-of-concept tool does, it just registers
# the function pointer. See MODDING.md's own "No dynamic loading in apps/server itself" entry
# for the full real rationale, including the real, considered error-handling policy (a bad
# mod is logged and skipped, never fatal to the server).
#
# Paths are relative to the PAPERCRAFT repo root, matching a real `bazel build //...` layout.
bazel-bin/packages/simulation/libxp_award_mod.so|on_papercraft_xp_for_object_destroyed
bazel-bin/packages/simulation/liblevel_mod.so|xp_required_for_level
bazel-bin/packages/simulation/liblevel_mod.so|on_papercraft_level_for_xp
bazel-bin/packages/simulation/libtalent_mod.so|on_papercraft_can_allocate_talent
